custom_logic_notes: Two separate EA files exist: one for buy signals (Heiken Ashi bullish engulfing) and one for sell signals (Heiken Ashi bearish engulfing). The engulfing pattern is detected on Heiken Ashi candles (not standard candles): a bullish engulfing requires the previous HA candle to be bearish and the current HA candle body to completely engulf the previous HA candle body. Digit adjustment multiplies SL/TP by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 to handle 5-digit/3-digit brokers. The sell EA is functionally the mirror of the buy EA with reversed engulfing conditions.
python_conversion_notes: Heiken Ashi is trivially reproducible in Python using OHLC data with the standard HA formulas. The engulfing pattern detection uses only HA_Open and HA_Close comparisons across current and previous bars. Digit adjustment logic should be replaced by direct point/pip conversion. The EA is split into two files (buy/sell) but the logic is symmetric—merge into a single Python class with direction parameter. No MQL5-specific API calls beyond standard CTrade market orders.
